column1: # Persian/Farsi (fas) book names and abbreviations for biblelib
# DRAFT - needs review by a native/liturgical Persian reader before release.
# Conventions: Protestant canon names follow the Biblica Open Persian Contemporary Bible 2022 (OPCB);
#   name = USFM \h/\toc2 short title with vowel diacritics (tashkil) removed, to ease matching and typing.
# Abbreviations: no single published standard exists. Derived from OPCB \toc3 short titles where those are
#   already short, otherwise truncated to the first 3-4 letters (Henry Martyn/Persian Bible style).
#   Ordinals use Persian digits as in OPCB (e.g. ۱ سموئیل); ordinal names are spelled out (اول، دوم، سوم).
# Deuterocanonical and extended-canon rows are NOT in OPCB; they are drafted from general knowledge of
#   Persian Catholic/Orthodox usage and transliteration, and have lower confidence.
